sourceTitle: Adoption, fostering and kinship care: Foster Allowances 2026/27 (Shetland Islands Council)
summary: Shetland Islands Council publishes its foster allowances for 2026/27 as a weekly amount for each child in three age bands, which match the Scottish Recommended Allowance for the year. The council's page does not publish a fee or reward paid to carers on top of the allowance, or any birthday or holiday payments, so ask the Family Placement Team what else applies.
